title: Google Announces Full Launch of Gemini Skills Gems Feature for Free Users, Historic Integration to Be Completed in November

content_html:
The accessibility threshold for AI personalization tools is experiencing a significant reduction. Google has recently officially announced that it will fully open the previously exclusive Gemini Skills custom command service, which was only available to Pro and Ultra paid subscribers, to all free account users, allowing more general users to benefit from the convenience of customized AI.

In terms of functional adjustments and smooth transition, as Skills become widely available, the original Gems feature will automatically transition and integrate into the newly upgraded Skills system on November 17, 2026. The upgraded Skills not only retain the previous flexible and powerful customization capabilities but also perform in-depth optimization of the underlying interaction logic. In the future, users will be able to instantly activate specific AI skills by typing a slash (/) followed by the corresponding command in the main chat box, making the operation more intuitive and efficient.

For the majority of free users, this system update balances convenience and stability. They can retain their previously created custom configurations and create new Skills conveniently through a dedicated link, achieving a seamless transition during the system migration. Industry analysis generally believes that by lowering the usage barrier of personalized AI, Google's move will further enhance user engagement and overall platform competitiveness of Gemini in the mass consumer market.
